caption_used: Mean absolute values of hidden states across model layers, comparing pre-gating, post-gating, and baseline configurations. The hidden state mean before gate (blue dashed line, avg 0.71) remains near zero through approximately layer 15, then rises sharply to a peak of roughly 2.8 at layer 23. The post-gating hidden state mean (orange dotted, avg 0.05) and baseline mean (green solid, avg 0.04) both remain close to zero throughout, with the baseline showing marginally higher values than the post-gating mean in the final layers. The dramatic pre-gating increase beginning at layer 12 demonstrates that gating effectively suppresses the activation amplification observed in deeper layers.

raw_responses.Bulgarian:
This line chart illustrates the mean absolute values of hidden states across model layers for three distinct configurations: pre-gating, post-gating, and baseline. The horizontal axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5, indicating a linear scale representing sequential model layers. The vertical axis, labeled “Abs Mean,” ranges from 0 to 4, also on a linear scale, and quantifies the mean absolute value of hidden states without specified units. Three distinct lines are plotted: a blue dashed line representing “hidden state mean before gate,” an orange dotted line for “hidden state mean after gate,” and a green solid line for “hidden state mean of baseline.” The blue dashed line begins near 0 at layer 0, remains relatively flat and close to zero until approximately layer 15, then rises sharply, reaching a peak of approximately 2.8 at layer 23. The orange dotted line remains near zero across all layers, with a slight upward trend visible only in the final layers, ending just above 0. The green solid line also remains near zero throughout, with a marginally higher value than the orange line in the final layers, ending slightly above 0.1. The legend indicates average values for each series: 0.71 for the blue line, 0.05 for the orange, and 0.04 for the green.

The green solid line, indicating "hidden state mean of baseline," also begins near 0.0 at layer 0, stays near zero through layer 20, and then shows a slight upward trend, reaching approximately 0.1 at layer 23.
